hero.title: Savour Authentic Indian Flavours at By 2 Coffee-Temple Meals
hero.subtitle: Discover time-honored recipes, rich heritage, and the perfect cup of coffee, shared with love.

about.title: Our Heritage, Your Home for Authentic Flavours
about.paragraph1: By 2 Coffee is a vibrant celebration of the incredible flavors and rich heritage of ethnic Indian cuisine. With time-honored recipes that tell stories of Indian traditions, every bite is a testament to our love and commitment. Since our establishment in 2012, we’ve become a beloved name in Bengaluru, known for our many outlets and loyal customer base. We invite you to savor the delicious delights that embody the true essence of Indian culinary excellence.
about.paragraph2: Our journey began in 2012, born from the simple, heartfelt idea of 'a cup of coffee split and shared by two.' More than just a name, By 2 Coffee is a trusted and cherished institution among lovers of traditional Idli-Vada and authentic Indian coffee. We take immense pride in our heritage, ensuring quality and community are at the heart of everything we serve, inviting you to join our story.
